# Disagreement Log — GTH_073

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 73
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 73 | "great" | "plentiful" | "vast" | *polus*: magnitude of harvest |
| 2 | 73 | "laborers" | "workers" | "workers" | *ergate*: laborers vs. workers |
| 3 | 73 | "Beseech" | "Pray" | "Ask" | Petition verb: intensity level |
| 4 | 73 | "into the harvest" | "into his harvest" | "out into the harvest" | LOGOS adds "his"; PNEUMA adds "out" — both expansions |

**Total disagreements: 4**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "great," "laborers," "Beseech," and the unmodified "into the harvest" (no additions).
